exports.index.js: public staging exports (config.js, adapter.js except invalid, service.js)

auth.identity: selected connection only; no credential mutation, cache, refresh, replay, pagination or failover

endpoints.validation: GET https://xquik.com/api/v1/x/tweets/search?q=test&limit=1 (source validator; billable per returned post; metadata only, never called here)

envelope.request: query string { q: trimmed query, queryType: provider_options.queryType | providerSpecificData.queryType | 'Latest', limit: min(max_results ?? 5, 20), sinceTime?: now - time_range }; headers { Accept: application/json, x-api-key }
envelope.response: { provider: 'xquik-search', query, results: SearchResult[] (local normalizers.js makeResult shape, metadata.source_type 'x', canonical https://x.com/<handle>/status/<id> or https://x.com/i/status/<id>), answer: null, usage: { queries_used: 1, search_cost_usd: 0.00075 }, metrics, errors: [] } rebuilt from validated tweets[]

integration.provider: new open-sse/providers/registry/xquik.js from xquikSearchProviderDefinition (category apikey, serviceKinds ['webSearch'], searchConfig with fallbackOnly) plus aliases 'xquik'/'xquik_search'; no existing provider changes
integration.search: open-sse/handlers/search/index.js handleSearchCore: dispatch handleXquikSearchNative for provider 'xquik-search' before tryDedicatedProvider; or add an 'xquik-search' GET builder to handlers/search/callers.js and normalizer to handlers/search/normalizers.js (the generic path would then lose input refusal, row validation and acceptedJob)
integration.route: src/sse/handlers/search.js: canonicalize 'xquik'/'xquik_search' to 'xquik-search' and force search_type 'x' for it (source executeWebSearch.ts / v1SearchSchema); enforce key model policy on the resolved id; time_range and provider_options are already forwarded in coreBody
integration.searchType: local search handlers and dashboard examples know only 'web'/'news'; registering 'x' needs the search_type select options and combo/auto selection to treat xquik-search as fallback-only (never auto-selected for 'web')
integration.validation: src/app/api/providers/validate: add the xquikValidationProbe request (source parity) or a documented no-charge probe; out of scope here
integration.accounting: result.accounting stays costStatus unknown with meta.returnedPosts; data.usage.search_cost_usd is the source registry estimate; acceptedJob marks possibly-billed failures
integration.catalog: docs/providers/catalog.mdx, public/providers icon and shared catalogs updated at serial registration only

restrictions: unregistered pending serial registration after four additions
search_type 'x' only ('web' canonicalized to 'x' as the source route does; 'news' refused)
country, language, offset, domain_filter, content_options, cursor, stream and unknown fields or provider_options keys are refused before submission (the source silently ignores them)
provider_options.queryType must be 'Latest' or 'Top' (the source silently maps anything else to Latest); time_range one of hour/day/week/month/year
max_results positive integer, clamped to 20; query trimmed, at most 2000 characters, no control characters
only rows with a numeric id, string text and (when present) a valid X handle are surfaced; citations are rebuilt on x.com, never taken from upstream URLs
non-object envelope, upstream error field or missing/non-array tweets is a malformed 502 (the source returns zero results)
15s default and maximum total deadline, 8MiB success and 16KiB error response bounds
upstream error messages and bodies are never relayed
no pagination (next_cursor is not surfaced), no answer synthesis, no streaming, no model discovery
